title: Findings (v1.2)
description: Issues found during review with severity, certainty, bilateral evidence, observation method, and review traceability. Severity ≠ certainty; potential_rejection requires bilateral evidence with parseable location.

findings_id.description: Stable identifier for this findings instance.

manifest_id.description: Must match the manifest_id from file-manifest.json for this review cycle.

findings.description: Array of individual findings/issues discovered during review.

issue_id.description: Stable unique identifier for this finding (e.g. 'I1', 'I2').

severity.description: Impact severity. potential_rejection=可能导致否决; high=重大问题; medium=中等问题; low=轻微问题; informational=仅供参考.

certainty.description: How certain the reviewer is about this finding. confirmed=已确认; likely=高度可能; uncertain=不确定; unverified=未验证. Severity ≠ certainty: high risk ≠ confirmed.

summary.description: Brief one-line summary of the finding. Retained from v1.2 reviewed contracts.

observation_method.description: Method used to observe/discover this finding (e.g. 'visual_read', 'text_comparison', 'calculation', 'render_view').

requirement_refs.description: References to requirements from the requirements matrix. Required for potential_rejection findings.

bid_evidence.description: Bid-side evidence supporting or contradicting the finding. Required for potential_rejection. Each entry specifies file, location, and evidence type.

image_evidence.description: Image/render evidence entries. Each must reference a valid file_id from the manifest.

review_status.description: Review status of this finding. open=已发现待初审; pending_review=待独立复核; reviewed_confirmed=复核确认; reviewed_downgraded=复核降级; reviewed_withdrawn=复核撤回. Authors must not self-claim reviewed without --review-pack.

limitations.description: Limitations, caveats, or reasons for downgrade/withdrawal. Each entry is a non-empty string.

description.description: Human-readable detailed description of the finding.

file_id.description: Optional: when present, must equal the referenced requirement's source_file_id. Used for clarity, not to override the canonical source.

location.description: Optional: narrowed location within the requirement's source clause. Must be within the range defined by the requirement's location.

file_id.description: file_id from file-manifest. Must NOT be a tender_document role file.

location.description: Precise location within the file. Required for present-type evidence.

evidence_type.description: present=evidence found at location; absence=evidence explicitly not found after search.

coverage_item_id.description: Optional: specific coverage item_id that established this evidence. Restricts coverage validation to that item.

searched_coverage_item_ids.description: Required for absence evidence: list of coverage item_ids that were checked and did not contain the evidence.

observation.description: What was observed or not observed at this evidence location. Retained from v1.2 reviewed contracts.

quote.description: Direct quote from the evidence source, if applicable.

file_id.description: file_id from file-manifest referencing an image or PDF page.

page_or_location.description: Specific page or location within the image/PDF.

description.description: What was observed in the image (text, chart, seal, etc.).

legibility.description: How legible the image content was. clear=可辨认; partially_legible=部分模糊; illegible=不可辨认.

legibility_notes.description: Details about illegible or partially legible areas (e.g. 'low resolution', 'obscured by watermark').
